title: Permit Coordinator: Renewal deadlines and lead times
notice: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
question: Which permit renewals have already missed their lead time, and how many days are left?

answer.question: Which permit renewals have already missed their lead time, and how many days are left?
answer.answer:
All 8 permits in the portfolio have missed their renewal lead time — none are currently compliant on that front. Here's the rundown (days left vs. expiration):

| Permit | Facility | Days Left | Required Lead Time |
|---|---|---|---|
| PRM-8101 Air Quality | Imperial Valley Solar | 18 | 90 days |
| PRM-8102 Environmental | Reno Wind Farm | 22 | 120 days |
| PRM-8103 Water Use | Phoenix Solar | 26 | 60 days |
| PRM-8104 Hazmat | Bakersfield Solar | 28 | 60 days |
| PRM-8105 Avian Protection | Tehachapi Wind | 29 | 90 days |
| PRM-8106 Noise Variance | Palm Springs Wind | 29 | 45 days |
| PRM-8107 Grading | Yuma Solar | 29 | 45 days |
| PRM-8108 Fire Code | Mojave Storage | 29 | 45 days |

All 8 are flagged critical (under 30 days left). Reno Wind Farm's environmental permit is the worst gap proportionally — 22 days left against a 120-day requirement. Want me to prepare the emergency renewal package for these?
